The following events took place in '''3649 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period|era]] between the [[Old Sith Wars|Old]] and [[New Sith Wars]].

==Events==
*[[Jura Ostrogoth]] arrived at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]].<ref name="Red Harvest2" />
*[[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agents carry out [[Operation Starbender]].<ref name="The Hidden Throne">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Hidden Throne|Isen Four}}</ref>
*[[Dorian Janarus]] is elected as the new [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="time">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' states that Janarus was elected in the immediate aftermath of the Treaty of Coruscant, placed in the year 3653 BBY by ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''. Janarus was the incumbent Supreme Chancellor in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which has early events in the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] class that must occur in [[3643 BBY]] due to [[Flesh Raider uprising#cite_note-Time-3|statements in various tie-in materials]]. The in-game Codex's "Republic Government" entry stated that "in recent years" there were campaigns for the position of Supreme Chancellor. Since portions of the game took place ten years after Janarus was elected, there must have been at least two election cycles in the intervening years.</ref><ref name="Holo">{{HolonetOld|biographies|supreme-chancellor-janarus|Supreme Chancellor Janarus}}</ref>
